sharedWithElectrical: ENG2005 (Advanced engineering mathematics), ENG4701/ENG4702 (Final year project A/B) and ENG0001 (Engineering CPD) are core requirements of BOTH the Civil and Electrical specialisations under E3001 — they live in electrical.json (tagged discipline:"common" there, not "electrical") rather than being duplicated here. The planner concatenates every catalog file into one list, so referencing their codes as prerequisites/corequisites from this file resolves fine without duplication.

https://handbook.monash.edu/2024/aos/CIVILENG03 (Civil engineering specialisation requirements — Part C core unit list, Part D professional practice, Part E elective study structure)

Course progression map PDF for E3001 (2024 commencing) exists at monash.edu but could not be fetched — direct download is Cloudflare-blocked for automated fetching (same block noted in electrical.json's research), and the r.jina.ai reader-proxy workaround used for the E3005 map hit an interactive 'verify you are human' Cloudflare challenge this session, which was not bypassed (bot-detection challenges are never completed by policy). Year/semester placement below is therefore Claude's own suggested sequencing from unit levels + validated prerequisite chains — same methodology and same caveat already used for the Commerce majors' Level 2/3 electives (see PROGRESS.md), not lifted from an official course-map PDF.
openDecisions: Part E — Civil engineering technical electives (36 credit points, single-degree students only) is a ~35-unit pool (Level 3/4/5: bridges into transport/traffic, water/hydrology, geotechnical, structures, plus cross-listed Resources Engineering and a few Level 5 postgrad-adjacent units) — deliberately NOT enumerated here, same call already made for Economics' elective pool and Business Analytics-adjacent lists in commerce.json: too large/open to be useful as catalog cards. Add specific ones as custom units once chosen. Double-degree students (e.g. a hypothetical Civil+Commerce) have this 36cp requirement waived entirely per the Handbook — 'already credited towards the double degree structure'.

CIV4249 (Foundation engineering) was NOT OFFERED in the 2024 Handbook at all — its page has no Offerings section, just a Notes line stating so directly. Kept in the catalog (it's a real, named Part C core unit with a real prerequisite chain) but semesterOffered is "unknown" rather than asserting a semester that didn't exist that year — re-check a live/current Handbook edition before actually enrolling in it.

CIV4286 (Project management for civil engineers) carries an explicit Handbook Notes instruction: 'Replace CIV4286 with one Professional Practice domain unit from Semester 2, 2024' — structurally identical to ECE4099's situation in electrical.json (a nominal core unit the Handbook itself says to swap for a self-chosen replacement). Kept at its nominal Y4 S1 slot with the replacement instruction in its notes, same treatment as ECE4099: add whichever Professional Practice unit is actually chosen as a custom unit.
Part D (Professional practice) requires ENG0001 at Clayton (ENG0002 at Malaysia) — already satisfied by electrical.json's ENG0001 entry (discipline:"common"), no new unit added here.

Year/semester placement for all 15 Civil-specific units below is Claude's suggested sequencing (unit level + validated prerequisite/corequisite chains, cross-checked so nothing is placed before its real prerequisites and every placement matches its actual Handbook-verified offering semester), not an official Monash course-map fact — see sources note above for why the actual PDF couldn't be fetched this session.

units.title: Structural materials
units.prerequisiteText: ENG1011 Engineering methods OR ENG1001 Engineering design: Lighter, faster, stronger
units.notes: Semester 2 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). Prohibited combination with CIV2225 (Design of steel and timber structures) and CIV3284 (Design of concrete and masonry structures) — older predecessor units this one appears to have absorbed/superseded.

units.title: Geomechanics 1
units.prerequisiteText: (ENG1011 Engineering methods OR ENG1001 Engineering design: Lighter, faster, stronger) AND (ENG1014 Engineering numerical analysis OR ENG1060 Computing for engineers)
units.notes: Semester 2 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). Prohibited combination with CIV2241 (older/equivalent Geomechanics 1 code) — this rule lives inside the Handbook's free-text 'Enrolment Rule' rather than a dedicated Prohibition accordion.

units.title: Structural mechanics
units.prerequisiteText: ENG1011 Engineering methods OR ENG1001 Engineering design: Lighter, faster, stronger

units.title: Water systems

units.notes: Semester 1 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). A special course-specific rule lets E3009 (Architectural Design double degree) students take ENG1005 and (ENG1014 or ENG1060) as corequisites instead of prerequisites — not applicable here.

units.title: Transport and traffic engineering
units.notes: Semester 1 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). No Requisites/Rules section exists at all on the 2024 Handbook page — genuinely no prerequisites, corequisites, or prohibitions.

units.title: Road engineering

units.title: Project management for civil engineers
units.prerequisiteText: Completion of 72 credit points of engineering study (Master of Professional Engineering E6011 students exempt).
units.notes: Handbook Notes instruct: 'Replace CIV4286 with one Professional Practice domain unit from Semester 2, 2024' — same pattern as ECE4099 in electrical.json. Nominal offering is Semester 1 only (Clayton and Malaysia), kept here as its documented slot; add the actual chosen Professional Practice replacement as a custom unit instead of enrolling in this code directly.

units.title: Civil and environmental engineering practice
units.prerequisiteText: No formal Requisites section — the rule lives as free text under Rules > Enrolment Rule. Civil engineering students: (CIV2282 OR CIV3283) AND CIV3221 AND (CIV3247 OR CIV3248) AND (CIV3294 Structural design OR CIV3284 Design of concrete and masonry structures OR CIV2226) AND (CIV3285 Engineering hydrology OR CIV3264). Environmental engineering students use an entirely different rule: (ENE3031 AND ENE3032) OR [ENE3606 AND (ENE2021 OR ENE3048) AND (CIV3285 OR CIV3264)] — not applicable to this Civil-only catalog.
units.notes: Handbook Overview calls this 'a capstone unit drawing together material from previous units' for a multi-disciplinary design project — kept as type "specialisation" (the degree's actual capstone is ENG4701/ENG4702, shared with Electrical). Semester 2 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia).
